What's new in 1.6.0

Save your details
- Data presets: save your name, links and options once, then switch to them instead of retyping. Choose a default that loads when the app opens.

Links and support
- Add 54 platforms with real brand badges, including Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, GitHub Sponsors, Buy Me a Coffee, Ko-fi and Patreon.
- Your GitHub Sponsors badge appears by itself if you have a Sponsors profile, and links you already list on GitHub fill in when you connect.
- Optional sponsor wall: thank your public sponsors in your README, grouped into top, monthly and one-time, without showing any amounts. Private sponsors are never included.

GitHub Sponsors pages
- Every template now has a second form: a themed page for your GitHub Sponsors profile, with its own data and presets.
- Upload the artwork, then copy and paste the text into your Sponsors dashboard. Your README isn't changed.

Also new
- An About screen with ways to support the project.
- A clear message if the WebView2 runtime is missing on Windows.
- The Microsoft Store version updates through the Store.
